entities.summary: Alain Robbe-Grillet was a French writer and filmmaker. He was one of the figures most associated with the Nouveau Roman trend of the 1960s, along with Nathalie Sarraute, Michel Butor and Claude Simon. Robbe-Grillet was elected a member of the Académie française on 25 March 2004, succeeding Maurice Rheims at seat No. 32. He married Catherine Robbe-Grillet. Alain Robbe-Grillet was a journalists & chroniclers from Saint-Pierre-Quilbignon (1922-08-18, Saint-Pierre-Quilbignon–2008-02-18). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
